svg.aria-label: Face-to-face console: a camera drum (left) and a microphone drum (right) feed the full-duplex press at the centre — Nuplex listens and speaks at the same time, so the die never waits for a turn to end. The press drives the screen on its beam, where Emma's face listens back. The reply-timing dial reads 89% (next closest system 35%, the dimmer needle). The approval lever between the persona and the tool-call drum gates every tool call; the stamp marks API video with a watermark; the kill-switch cable runs from the safety checker to the press and ends the call on a forbidden ask. Verified numbers (Nuance Labs, launched Nov 9, 2026): 89% reply-timing overlap, next best 35%, 1,785 questions measured, 18 months of research, English only for now, 18+ only.
svg.text: 89% reply timing · next best 35% · 1,785 questions · NOV 9, 2026 · ENGLISH ONLY · 18+
